question: Which supreme court judge has surved in international court of justice?
text:
If you mean the **Supreme Court of India**, Justice **Dalveer Bhandari** joined the International Court of Justice (ICJ) on April 27, 2012, and was re-elected for a second term beginning in 2018. ([sci.gov.in](https://www.sci.gov.in/judge/justice-dalveer-bhandari/?utm_source=openai))

Justice **R. S. Pathak**, a former Chief Justice of India, also served on the ICJ, from 1989 to 1991. ([sci.gov.in](https://www.sci.gov.in/judge/justice-r-s-pathak/?utm_source=openai))
